name: Skin Inferno — Cuerpo
generation_strategy: IMAGEN COMBINADA 1536×1024: skin body (izquierda) + cañón temático (derecha).

frames.role: Cuerpo del tanque skin Inferno (fuego/lava) — skin legendaria
frames.prompt:
TWO cartoon tank sprites side by side on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Both viewed strictly from directly above at 90 degrees (bird's eye zenith view, only TOP SURFACE visible). STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon art, Brawl Stars quality, bold dark charcoal outlines, smooth cel-shading gradients.

LEFT PANEL — INFERNO TANK BODY (fire/lava legendary skin): Deep crimson-red (#CC2200) tank body. The roof surface has: layered armor panels with bold flame-shaped decorative paint — cartoon flame motifs (bold orange-yellow pointed flame shapes) integrated into the armor panels, circular turret ring, armored hatch with flame accent. TWO SEGMENTED TRACK STRIPS on left/right edges (dark warm gray, individual track links). Cel-shading: bright warm orange-red glowing highlight, rich red mid-tone, dark maroon shadow. A subtle warm orange edge glow suggesting heat. Chunky squat proportions.

RIGHT PANEL — INFERNO CANNON (matching fire theme): Same narrow elongated rectangle shape pointing UP (12 o'clock), base wider. Deep red-black (#330000) with orange energy line highlight along the barrel. Matching fire aesthetic. Bold charcoal outline.

Strictly top-down. NO front/side face. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic fire, pixel art, military realism, blue colors, cute/innocent look, text, watermark, background scenery, realistic lava
